acceptance: A scheduled audit on develop opens the bump PR or an issue when an advisory lands; decide whether the PR-level dependency-audit blocks only on advisories the PR introduces.
description: 2026-10-31: pyasn1 0.6.4 gained CVE-2026-119194/5/6/7 (fixed in 0.6.5) and dependency-audit failed on every open PR, including release PRs; PR #3894 fixed it after an agent diagnosed it from a failing PR. Nothing detects a new advisory on develop before PRs fail, and the check fails PRs that did not cause it.
